title: Kissed Saudi Sesame Tagine
description: A fragrant, low-fat tagine filled with smoky chickpeas, caramelized onions, and a velvety tahini‑sesame sauce, finished in parchment papillote for a cozy, family-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, and a pinch of sea salt, cooking for another minute.
Add cooked chickpeas, mixing to coat with spices and onion mixture, and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in tahini and lemon juice, whisking until a smooth sauce forms and the dish is heated through.
Transfer mixture to parchment paper, fold into a tight papillote, and seal the edges.
Bake the papillote for 15 minutes, then carefully open, drizzle toasted sesame seeds over the top, and fold back.
Let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with a side of whole‑grain couscous or low‑fat plain yogurt if desired.
